title: Getting-close alerts: halfway to a take-profit, near a stop
body:
A heads-up before Tippy buys or sells: when a coin is part of the way from your entry to its next take-profit (50% and 90% by default), or within 20% above a stop. Choose the milestones, the stop distance and a daily cap per coin in Settings → Alerts.

Done in 887f984 — ships in the next version.

title: Control Tippy from Telegram: see your orders, pause and resume
body:
/orders lists every coin Tippy is guarding and its next levels. /pause and /resume work for everything or one coin (/pause $TIPPY). Commands reach Tippy on your computer within about a minute; nothing is sold or bought from Telegram.

Done in main — ships in the next version.

title: Telegram: cancel a coin's orders
body:
/cancel $COIN stops guarding a coin from your phone. Nothing gets sold. Also cancels its limit buys; one coin at a time.

Done in main — ships in the next version.

title: Telegram: sell from your phone, with a confirmation step
body: /sell $COIN 50% asks you to confirm with a one-time code before Tippy sells on your computer. Off until you switch it on in Tippy's settings, because anyone in your Telegram could use it.

title: Ask-first stop losses on Telegram after a sleep
body: With "Ask me first" on, a stop that hit while your computer was asleep asks on Telegram — Sell now or Keep — instead of waiting for you at the computer.

title: Take out my initials
body: One tap sells exactly enough at your chosen multiple (2x by default) to get your original money back, so the rest rides for free.

title: Break-even stop after the first take-profit
body: Once take-profit 1 fills, Tippy can move your stop up to your entry, so a winning trade can't turn into a loss.

title: Alert-only levels
body: "Tell me if it hits $1M" without selling anything — on fomo, as a desktop notification and on Telegram.

title: Show trailing stops by default
body: Trailing stops are built but hidden behind a setting. Put them in Tippy's window for everyone.

title: History of what Tippy did, with CSV export
body: A list of every fill with what it made or saved, and a CSV download for your records.

title: Laddered limit buys
body: Split a buy into steps: $10 at $500K, $10 at $400K, $10 at $300K.

title: Time-based exits
body: "If it hasn't hit 2x in 24 hours, sell half."

title: Per-coin presets for Auto-guard
body: Different rules for big and small coins, chosen by market cap when Auto-guard picks up a new buy.

title: Edge Add-ons listing
body: Publish Tippy on Microsoft Edge Add-ons, so Edge users install it from Microsoft's own store.

title: "What's new" page on tippybot.fun
body: A dated changelog on the website, from CHANGELOG.md.

title: Feature videos on the Features page
body: Each of the eight 20-second feature videos next to the feature it shows.

title: Help guides
body: First setup, keeping Chrome awake, Telegram setup, and what happens if your laptop sleeps.

title: A GitHub release for every store version
body: Each Chrome Web Store version gets a matching tagged release with its changelog, so anyone can check the published extension against the code.
